conflicts.statement: Release from NB539 at 18:40Z on 3 Nov to report for NB696 at 04:40Z on 4 Nov is 10h00 of rest at MAD. With 85 minutes of commute at each end coming out of that rest, only 7h10 remains for sleep — 50 minutes short of the required 8 uninterrupted hours, and no arrangement of sleep inside the window can recover it.
options: Push the 4 Nov report to 06:20Z or later
Pull the 3 Nov release earlier
Provide accommodation at the airport so the commute does not consume the rest
Remove the 4 Nov MAD-FCO-MAD duty from the pairing

conflicts.statement: The rest at base between NB539 (release 18:40Z, 3 Nov) and NB696 (report 04:40Z, 4 Nov) is 10h00, two hours under the 12h company standard for home-base rest.
options: Delay the 4 Nov report to 06:40Z or later
Reassign the 4 Nov FCO turn to another crew member
